items.note: macOS Golden Gate’s animated wallpaper and screen saver: light by day, dark at night. Download saves the landscape videos, Portrait the portrait ones.
macOS Tahoe’s animated wallpaper and screen saver: light by day, dark at night. Download saves the landscape videos, Portrait the portrait ones.
macOS Sonoma’s animated wallpaper and screen saver: light by day, dark at night. Download saves the landscape videos, Portrait the portrait ones.
Apple’s Day from 10:00, Sunset from 17:00, Evening from 18:00, Night from 21:00 aerials as one set. Download saves the videos; Wallpaper Engine builds one wallpaper that follows the clock.
Apple’s Morning from 06:00, Day from 10:00, Evening from 18:00, Night from 21:00 aerials as one set. Download saves the videos; Wallpaper Engine builds one wallpaper that follows the clock.
Apple’s Sunrise from 05:00, Morning from 06:00, Night from 21:00 aerials as one set. Download saves the videos; Wallpaper Engine builds one wallpaper that follows the clock.
